challenges.name: courier-matching-circuit-breaker
challenges.title: A circuit breaker for courier matching
challenges.description: order-service calls courier-matching for every placed order. When courier-matching degraded last week, order-service kept calling it, every call waited 3 s, and the order page timed out; a hand-written breaker that followed made it worse by opening on the first error and on customers' validation errors. The editor holds `Main.java` with a breaker modelled on Resilience4j's count-based CircuitBreaker, its key blocks missing, each marked by a `// [ ]` line; some pieces are wrong on purpose. Fill every line so that: while OPEN, calls are rejected until `openMs` have passed, then the next call moves it to HALF_OPEN; 400 responses go through but are not recorded, errors count as failures and calls longer than `slowMs` as slow; in CLOSED it opens only once at least `minCalls` calls are in the window and the failure rate or slow-call rate reaches its threshold; in HALF_OPEN it decides only after all `halfOpenCalls` trial calls are recorded. The test runner replays timed calls and prints the state before each call, its result and every change of state.
hints: Write the state after each call of a test on paper: which calls enter the window, how many are in it when the breaker decides, and which calls never reach the service at all?

Look at the order of the blocks in `onCall`: the OPEN check comes first (it may change the state), then the decision whether to record the call, then one decision for CLOSED (needs `minCalls`) and one for HALF_OPEN (needs all trial calls).

A breaker around a maps API that ignores 404s: `if (now < retryAt) return REJECTED; if (code == 404) return PASS_THROUGH; recent.add(code >= 500);` and in CLOSED `if (recent.size() >= 20 && failurePercent() >= 40) open(now);`, in HALF_OPEN `if (recent.size() >= 5) { if (failurePercent() >= 40) open(now); else close(); }`.

tests.name: Healthy traffic with a few errors stays closed
tests.input:
config window=10 minCalls=5 failureRate=50 slowMs=1000 slowRate=80 openMs=5000 halfOpenCalls=3
call t=0 ok 120
call t=100 ok 90
call t=200 error 300
call t=300 ok 110
call t=400 ok 95
call t=500 ok 130
call t=600 error 250
call t=700 ok 100
call t=800 ok 100
call t=900 ok 100
tests.expected:
t=0 CLOSED ok
t=100 CLOSED ok
t=200 CLOSED error
t=300 CLOSED ok
t=400 CLOSED ok
t=500 CLOSED ok
t=600 CLOSED error
t=700 CLOSED ok
t=800 CLOSED ok
t=900 CLOSED ok
state=CLOSED

tests.name: An error burst opens it once 5 calls are recorded; calls are then rejected

call t=100 error 300
call t=200 error 280
call t=300 ok 150
call t=400 error 310
call t=500 ok 100
call t=3000 ok 100
call t=5399 ok 100
tests.expected:
t=0 CLOSED ok
t=100 CLOSED error
t=200 CLOSED error
t=300 CLOSED ok
t=400 CLOSED error
t=400 CLOSED -> OPEN
t=500 OPEN rejected
t=3000 OPEN rejected
t=5399 OPEN rejected
state=OPEN
